verses.1: And I am in my second year of studying Daryoush’s teachings. I stand here to learn and to follow his instructions.
verses.2: And now, in truth, I will tell you that there are still three kings who stand in Persia. And the fourth king will be the most powerful of all. With his strength, he will build a kingdom that will be great.
verses.3: And the king stood up, a powerful ruler and master over many people. He did as he wished.
verses.4: And when he stood up, his kingdom would be destroyed. It would last for four days in the sky. But it wouldn’t last forever. It wouldn’t last as long as his reign did. And others would take over from him.
verses.5: And let the king of the Negeb be strengthened, along with his ministers. Let him be empowered over them all. And let him rule over them as a great ruler.
verses.6: And after two years, they would get married. Then, the daughter of the king of the Negev would go to the king of the Sefi’im to do good deeds. She wouldn’t let the power of the enemy get the best of her. She would not stand against it. She would give birth to children and strengthen them during those difficult times.
verses.7: And he stood at the entrance of their roots, and he went into the army. He went along with the king of the Zaphon. He did whatever he wanted with them, and he held them captive.
verses.8: And their livestock, along with all their treasures, including silver and gold, would be brought from Egypt. And they would stand before the king of Assyria for years.
verses.9: And in the kingdom of King Negeb, he came back to his own land.
verses.10: And its branches will grow and gather together many flocks. Then it will come forth, flow over, and settle down, until it reaches its full growth.
verses.11: And the king of the Negeb will be defeated. He will go out and fight against the king of the Tzafon. He will stand firm, and he will give battle with his hands.
verses.12: And the hen was lifted up, and her heart became high-spirited. She threw her eggs down, and she couldn’t fly anymore.
verses.13: And the king of Tzafon came back, and he set up a monument that was much larger than before. In a few years, it would be filled with a large army and plenty of treasures.
verses.14: And in those times, many will stand against the king of the Negev. And the sons of your people will be taken captive to serve as slaves. They will be defeated and humiliated.
verses.15: And the king of Saba will come, and he will pour out his blood. He will destroy a city from within its walls. Its inhabitants and their descendants will not be able to stand up anymore. There will be no strength left for them to fight back.
verses.16: And he will do what he wants to him. He will not stand before him. He will stand in the land of the wild animals, and he will hold everything in his hands.
verses.17: And he will set his face toward coming against all of his kingdom. And the righteous will be with him. But he will give women to corrupt them. They will not stand, nor will they be able to do anything.
verses.18: And he will turn his face toward the islands, and he will kill many people. But his shame will be taken away from him, and he will be restored to his honor.
verses.19: And his face will be turned towards the ruins of his land. He will fail and fall, and he will not be able to rise again.
verses.20: And upon his throne stood someone who would carry on the reign of kings. In certain days, this reign will be completed, but not through violence or war.
verses.21: And he stood on his throne, but they did not give him any honor or respect as a king. He ruled in humiliation, and he held power in a state of chaos.
verses.22: And the branches of the vine were cut off from before him, and they were destroyed. And also, the covenant was broken.
verses.23: And from his friendship, he will commit a deception. He will also rise up and become powerful in some of the nations.
verses.24: In the days of prosperity and in the days of great wealth, he will come and do what his fathers never did. He will give them land and wealth. He will treat the poor with fairness and justice.
verses.25: And he will mobilize his strength and his heart against the king of Negeb. The king of Negeb will be forced to fight against a large army. He will be overwhelmed by fear, and he will not be able to stand up because people will think badly of him.
verses.26: And those who eat the bread of Baal will be destroyed; their armies will be defeated, and many of them will fall as prisoners.
verses.27: And both kings, with their hearts set on evil, spoke together from one table. But it will not succeed, for there is still a long way to go before the appointed time arrives.
verses.28: And he settled in his land, with great blessings upon him. His heart was filled with the Holy Covenant. And he returned to his land.
verses.29: At the appointed time, he will return. He will come down from the mountain. But he won’t be like before, nor will he be the same as ever.
verses.30: And they came with their idols, with their false gods. They were filled with anger and hatred towards the covenant of God. They acted in a way that was contrary to the laws of God’s covenant.
verses.31: And from them shall come forth sprouts. They will stand in the holy place, and they will fill it with noise. They will remove the permanence from it, and they will give place to light instead.
verses.32: And the children of the covenant shall be strengthened in their regions, and those who know their God shall be reinforced and strengthened.
verses.33: And those who are wise among the people will understand many things. But they will also fail in their efforts, both in darkness and in light, during these days.
verses.34: And in their downfall, they will be helped by a little help, and many will accompany them in their downfall.
verses.35: And from those who are wise, they will be destroyed in their own homes. They will be tried and punished until the end, when it’s time for judgment.
verses.36: And it was done as the king wished. It became greater and more powerful, and it could speak to all gods. It brought glory and success to everyone. All anger was extinguished because it was created in accordance with God’s will.
verses.37: And he will not understand the gods of his fathers, nor the desires of women, nor any other gods. For all things are greater than them.
verses.38: And they will honor the gods who they can worship. They will also honor those gods whom their ancestors did not know. They will worship them with gold, silver, precious stones, and other expensive gifts.
verses.39: And he made for the prisoners of Mausims an altar for the foreign god. This god would be honored greatly, and his followers would divide up the land among themselves.
verses.40: And at the time of his death, the king of the Negeb would be defeated by the king of the Tzafon. He would be carried away on chariots and horses, along with many other people. He would also be taken to various lands, and then destroyed.
verses.41: And in the land of the Zebulunites, many people were destroyed. These people were taken captive by Adam and Mawav. They were also among the first descendants of the people of Zebulun.
verses.42: And he will stretch out his hand over the lands; but Egypt’s land will not be given as a refuge.
verses.43: And he ruled over all the treasures of gold and silver, as well as over all the delicacies of Egypt.
verses.44: And their voices will be heard from the east and from the north. They will come forth in a great fire, to destroy and to annihilate many.
verses.45: And my tent will be destroyed between the seas and Mount Zion. He will come to Kitzur, but there will be no one to save him.
